heldReason: 瀆: the dictionary writes the middle of 賣 as 四 (a short sweep and a small fold inside) while the pinned MM candidate writes 罒 with two inner verticals; neither stroke can be derived from a vertical's own points, and no Ja or Ko 18-stroke candidate exists (same form difference as 犢·牘·竇). 疼: the dictionary finishes 冬 with a long stroke rising to the right while the pinned MM candidate draws a short dot; the dot's points cannot give the stroke its length or direction (as 砥 was held for 氐's bar). A 10-stroke Ja candidate exists for 疼 and a later batch could pin it.

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors

retainedAfterInspection.reason: Both draw the right top stroke of 兼 descending to the lower left; the dictionary sweeps it flatter (61° from MM's short stroke). Reflecting or reversing the licensed stroke would turn it away from the observed direction, so the licensed geometry is kept.

subThresholdSlants.note: Short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them, below the inspection threshold, among the 48 approved glyphs. Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); the offset does not change stroke directions.
